Gold (CNY)|CNY_per_troy_ounce.source: World Bank Pink Sheet gold monthly average × monthly USD/CNY

limitations: Only S&P 500 CAPE, S&P 500 trailing PE and RMB gold spot-price valuation are included in this tranche.

CSI 300 and Hang Seng monthly index valuation history require a verifiable public raw data feed or licensed provider; a Lixinger API token is required for its documented historical index fundamentals endpoint.

Nasdaq-100 complete monthly valuation history is not available in Siblis free tier; full historical database is subscription data. Public page snapshots are not treated as a continuous monthly series.
CAPE and trailing PE are different metrics and must not be compared as if identical.
Gold has no PE/PB; monthly CNY spot price percentile is a price-history indicator, not intrinsic-value valuation.
No interpolation, forward filling, or extrapolation is applied; rolling percentile is blank until a full 60/120-month window exists.

Only completed calendar months are included; the in-progress current month is excluded. The Multpl CAPE source labels monthly observations on the first calendar day of the month; the month label is retained and not misrepresented as a month-end close.
Additional public Nasdaq-100 annual PE observations (1990-2025) have been archived separately; they are not monthly and are excluded from 5Y/10Y monthly percentile calculations.
CSI300, HSI and NDX public point-in-time snapshots have been archived separately for audit; snapshots are not a substitute for historical monthly observations.

CSI300 source Index Lab reports 258 valuation samples since 2005-04-29, but the underlying raw monthly observations were not exposed in the accessible page text during this retrieval; current PE/PB values are retained as point-in-time snapshots only.

HSI official website exposes a historical PE download entry and daily index reports, but a bulk historical file with monthly raw observations was not retrievable from the accessible public page in this pass.

nasdaq100_annual_pe.coverage: 1990-2025 annual year-end values plus 2026-11 partial current-month observation
nasdaq100_annual_pe.note: Annual values are not monthly observations and are excluded from monthly rolling percentile calculations.

public_snapshots.note: Snapshots are retained separately and never merged into monthly history; reported percentile labels may differ by source methodology.
